findings.description: The statement says each per-code count includes every detection after the power-on reset. SYS-SAFE-017 assigns detections to separate fault-code counts, and SYS-SAFE-018 returns each count to zero after 60 s of fault-free operation, as required by CON-SUP-140.
findings.requested_change: Limit the initialization outcome to preserving subsequent detections in their corresponding per-code counts, subject to the reset rule in SYS-SAFE-018.
